speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you haven't provided any symptoms yet; please tell me if you are experiencing fatigue, night sweats, unexplained weight loss, or abdominal pain. Additionally, have you noticed any enlarged lymph nodes, particularly in the supraclavicular area?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a very concerning combination of symptoms. Have you noticed any lumps in your neck or armpits recently? Also, have you experienced any changes in your bowel movements, such as blood in the stool or persistent diarrhea?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma.

Based on the classic B symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss) combined with painless, fixed supraclavicular lymphadenopathy and abdominal pain, this presentation is highly suspicious for lymphoma or malignancy. REQUEST IMAGES: CT_Abdomen_Pelvis, Chest_CT.
